title: 瑞银：美债收益率上行 美联储或加息两次
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: There are a lot of people watching this right now rolling their eyes and saying that's not what's going on.
segments.zh: 现在很多人看到这个都在翻白眼，说根本不是这么回事。

segments.en: Nice to talk about the deficit. Great excuse to worry about it, but that's not really what's driving yields where they are.
segments.zh: 谈赤字挺好，是担心它的好借口，但这并不是真正推动收益率到当前水平的原因。

segments.en: If you look at bond yields in the United States, 10-year yields, the highest levels going back to 2024 over in Germany is the highest level going back to 2011.
segments.zh: 看看美国债券收益率，10年期收益率是2024年以来的最高水平，德国则是2011年以来的最高。

segments.en: This is a global move spurred on by a whole host of other issues.
segments.zh: 这是一场由一系列其他问题推动的全球性变动。

segments.en: How would you respond? I mean, how much of this is deficit versus just the global inflationary moment that we're in?
segments.zh: 你会怎么回应？我的意思是，这有多少是赤字，有多少只是我们身处全球通胀时刻？

segments.en: Right, so if we want to talk about the current bond market and the forces that are driving yields higher, it is definitely not just the deficit.
segments.zh: 对，所以如果我们想谈论当前债券市场和推动收益率上升的力量，那绝对不只是赤字。

segments.en: It is concerns that we don't know the Fed path is one that occurred after the July meeting.
segments.zh: 这是对美联储路径不确定的担忧，这种担忧在7月会议后出现。

segments.en: It is a shrinking buyer base of price and sensitive buyers thinking about central banks, for example, that are just not in the market as much and that's got to be absorbed by private markets.
segments.zh: 是价格敏感买家基础在萎缩，比如央行，它们不再那么频繁入市，这必须由私人市场来吸收。

segments.en: And then it's the AI build out. It's the AI data centers that are in the back end of the curve, issuing long duration because they have long duration infrastructure assets that they're building.
segments.zh: 然后是AI建设。AI数据中心在曲线后端发行长期债券，因为它们正在建设长期基础设施资产。

segments.en: So they're matching their assets and their liability stream makes sense, but that's a new market entrant that is just drawing supply.
segments.zh: 所以它们匹配资产和负债流是合理的，但这是一个新的市场进入者，正在吸收供应。

segments.en: So the question is just what's the price that's going to equalize that?
segments.zh: 所以问题就在于，什么价格才能实现平衡？

segments.en: The worst thing that can happen is that you undermine the risk-free rate at a time when you need the capital to build out the AI data centers which create the productivity enhancements that
segments.zh: 最糟糕的情况是，在你需要资金建设AI数据中心以提升生产力时，却削弱了无风险利率。
